name: Dried macadamia
summary: Dried macadamia, prized for its aroma and taste, from orchards that skip herbicide, chemical pesticide, and heavy inorganic fertilizer. More than 1,000 hectares grow at Quảng Trực in Tuy Đức.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022, page titled Mắc ca sấy. The 2024 handbook has a matching nut note under hạt macca.
howToEat: The tourism portal says growers use a traditional method: no herbicide, no chemical pesticide, and no heavy use of inorganic fertilizer. Eat the dried nut or carry it home.
The same portal says more than 1,000 hectares of macadamia grow at Quảng Trực in Tuy Đức.
where: Quảng Trực, Tuy Đức, for the orchard belt.
seoTitle: Mac ca say — dried macadamia from Dak Nong
seoDescription: Dried macadamia from Dak Nong. The tourism portal says the farms skip herbicide and chemical pesticide.
